headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Shed $487 Million as Bitcoin Holds Near 83k and Greed Runs Ahead of a Flat Cycle
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487 million on the Oct. 7 print, ether funds lost $160.8 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin trades near 83k after a decline of nearly 1%. Fear and greed reads 57, labeled greed, while the cycle index sits flat at 55, so sentiment is running ahead of the cash leaving the funds and the cycle score. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short print, the dollar is firm at 102.39, and volatility is quiet, with the VIX at 15.21 and seven-day realized volatility at 22.85% against 49.25% over thirty days, so the outflow is meeting shorts rather than a leverage chase or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
